ABOUT GETI

Building Skills for a Global Future

Global English Teaching Institute (GETI) is an English education and professional training platform dedicated to helping learners and teachers develop practical English language and teaching skills.

Our approach combines structured learning, practical communication, professional development, TEFL, TESOL and assessment.

GETI EXAM OVERVIEW

Teaching Qualifications at a Glance

Compare the purpose and assessment focus of the three principal GETI English teaching examinations.

TESOL
PurposeTeaching English to speakers of other languages
AssessmentKnowledge, planning and classroom application
TESOL exams assess the knowledge and practical skills required to teach English to speakers of other languages. Candidates demonstrate lesson planning, language awareness, classroom management, assessment, learner support and professional judgment. Available course hours offer progressive challenge, with clear pass requirements and automatic correction for an efficient, consistent examination experience.
TEFL
PurposeTeaching English as a foreign language
AssessmentMethods, language knowledge and teaching practice
TEFL exams measure readiness to teach English as a foreign language in international classrooms. Each assessment reviews teaching methods, grammar, pronunciation, lesson preparation, classroom practice and learner evaluation. Exam duration and difficulty increase with course hours, helping candidates demonstrate stronger competence before earning a verified GETI teaching certificate online successfully.
TEYL
PurposeTeaching English to young learners
AssessmentAge-appropriate, safe and engaging instruction
TEYL exams focus on teaching English effectively to children and young learners. Candidates are assessed on age appropriate instruction, engaging lesson structure, simple language presentation, classroom routines, safeguarding awareness and supportive feedback. Different study hours provide suitable progression while the examination checks practical understanding, confidence and responsible teaching decisions independently.
